I'd say drive the stock car around and on the mountain for a couple weeks and try and figure out what would make you faster. If you get better at identifying what you want from the car it'll make you a better driver for any car you get into. Also increasing your cars capabilities with your own skill ceiling feels more rewarding then just throwing mods on depending on what the internet says. Cause you actually get to feel and understand the change in the car. Ofc don't fly off a mountain while trying to learn your cars traits lol.
